answer: One concrete defense is bonded staking: every agent posts refundable collateral that gets slashed on misbehavior, so spinning up a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand real bonds. Picture the network as a haven whose only jetty is a staking gate, each berth demanding capital to dock. Like a juniper trying to root in thin gravel, a sybil swarm cannot anchor without paying, and the economics quietly price fake identities out of existence.
